name: Caustic Shower AP OLD
description: Contact with the doors, pillars, or statue causes a shower of acid.
disable: DC 48 Crafting (master) to ground the charged features or DC 50 Thievery (legendary) to disable the contact sensors

generalAbilities.name: Acid Shower
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature touches the doors, pillars, or statue directly or with a tool

Effect A shower of acid rains down from the ceiling, dealing (8d10+48) Acid Damage damage to all creatures in the chamber (Basic DC 44 Reflex Saving Throw). On a critical failure, a creature additionally takes 1d10 Persistent,acid Damage damage.
